items.title: Dan Wall and Adam Nussbaum interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: I talked to Pat LaBarbara today, he’s going to go out and play with Elvin again.

ctx.x: Well I’m sure both of you guys are putting a lot away towards retirement.

What am I going to retire to? What am I going to retire to? That’s the great thing. I mean I look at James Moody, he’s 76. I talked to Pat LaBarbara today, he’s going to go out and play with Elvin again. You know Elvin is 73. These guys are only getting better. What are they going to do go play golf? I mean they’re still getting better. I mean that’s the great thing about being a musician. It’s like every day I look forward to playing because there’s going to be something different than the day before. I mean I…
I hate to think what you would retire to, really. I wouldn’t want to be around.
